honesty.statement: Models learn measured spectra from PubChem/NIST facts, graph topology and, for *_geant4 entries, the Geant4 atomic response (mean excitation energy, photo-absorption cross sections) as inputs. Labels are measurements: these are learned predictions for comparison, not Geant4 results.
